title: Post-Operative Nausea And Vomiting Study In Female Patients
brief_summary: The primary purpose of this study is to determine an effective dose of this NK-1 anti-emetic medication to prevent nausea and vomiting in females after surgery.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Known, specified risk factors for PONV (post operative nausea and vomiting)
* Undergoing gynecologic or gallbladder surgery.

Exclusion Criteria:

* pregnant or breastfeeding
* post-menopausal
